data.name: Use those vehicles
data.author: dr.RazdalByte
data.description:
Based on Rev:1.6
Changes vehicle fight tactic to who first sees - wins. Hide around corners, dig in, set ambushes, shot at long distances. 2 operators can focus fire entire convoy. Vehicles are fast in water and turrets can fight ships.
Suggestions on how to play: -If you're flying, don't do it low, slow, or both, it's dangerous for your well-being. -If you're driving, being out of cover, in open, alone, or both, is dangerous for your well-being. -2x30mm can outgun entire convoy from cover or corner. -Engagements are lightning quick so spin the tower 360. -Fight two islands at a time, ground, air, or combine. -MULs are backbone for long range operations.
